npcs.official_english_description: A young lady who is running a game she calls "Theater Mechanicus" during the Lantern Rite. She has just invented the game, which is played with just a table, a few chess pawns, and a host. Because the game is still relatively unknown, and Ruijin would like to get more feedback from players, there is a special Lantern Rite discount: a match costs only one Xiao Lantern. Reportedly, in order to popularize "Theater Mechanicus" across other parts of Teyvat, she has come up with an ambitious update schedule with a new version of the game being released every six weeks, which seems quite challenging for one person to handle.|Theater Mechanicus Map Icon
